message.content:
Tesla has **not** released a Model S (or any other vehicle) on sale in India as of now.  
While several reports have floated potential entry dates—most recently suggesting a launch sometime in late‑2025—the company’s own Indian website still lists “Not Available” under all models, and no official retail price has been announced.

If you’re looking at pre‑orders or import options:

| Option | Status |
|--------|--------|
| Direct purchase from Tesla.com (US/UK sites) + custom import duties | Possible, but requires arranging shipping & customs clearance yourself – costs vary widely. |
| Import via third‑party dealers / private sellers | Rarely seen; prices often inflated due to high duty rates. |

For reference, when Tesla first entered markets like China and Mexico it priced its vehicles roughly $10–15 % higher than U.S. MSRP after adding local taxes and tariffs. If similar patterns hold in India, a Model S could end up costing well over ₹2 crore ($250 000 USD), though this is purely speculative until Tesla confirms availability.

---

### Bottom line

*No official Model S sales exist in India.*  
Keep an eye on Tesla’s press releases and reputable automotive news outlets—they’ll announce anything concrete once the company decides to enter the market.
